svg.text: NETFLIX STREAMING — one system, two planes
Dashed = control flow (decisions, tiny). Thick = data flow (the bytes, almost all the traffic).
The two planes run on different hardware, in different buildings, often owned by different companies.
Documented failure mode: an OCA that loses contact with the AWS control plane stops serving traffic.
Source: Netflix Open Connect documentation and the Netflix Technology Blog.
